skill.name: healthcare-job-search
skill.description: Find open US healthcare jobs (nursing, CNA, allied health, therapy, imaging, pharmacy, physicians and more) and the hourly pay employers post, using CareJobs.Now's free MCP server or its public JSON endpoints. Use when someone asks for healthcare or nursing jobs in a US place, what a healthcare job pays, or which hospitals are hiring.
skill.summary: Search US healthcare openings and compare employer-posted hourly pay through CareJobs.Now.
skill.author: yumaheymans

content.user_title: Find US Healthcare Jobs and Posted Pay
content.value_statement: Healthcare job seekers need openings and posted pay in one place. This skill guides CareJobs.Now searches and presents matching roles with employer details and application links.
actual_capabilities: Guide healthcare job searches using role, location, shift, keywords, and pay filters through the CareJobs.Now MCP tools.
Present matching titles, employers, locations, posted pay, and job links returned by the service.
Retrieve employer-posted hourly pay medians and typical ranges by healthcare job type.
Query open jobs and employer counts by state or job type.
Retrieve market summaries, covered employers, and individual employer job and pay information.
Use public JSON endpoints for pay summaries and job counts when MCP access is unavailable.
limitations: Coverage is limited to US employers tracked by CareJobs.Now, not every healthcare vacancy.
Live results require network access and a compatible MCP client or HTTP retrieval tool.
Posted pay is not guaranteed compensation and excludes shift differentials and bonuses in the instructed summaries.
The skill does not submit applications, verify hiring outcomes, or provide detailed vacancy searches through the two public JSON endpoints.

use_cases.title: Find nursing openings
use_cases.description: Search for ICU nursing roles in a chosen city and shift, then review employer details and application links.

use_cases.title: Compare posted pay
use_cases.description: Review median hourly pay and typical ranges for allied health roles using employer-posted rates.
use_cases.target_user: Allied health professionals considering a career move

use_cases.title: Research hiring markets
use_cases.description: Compare state-level openings and covered employers to identify markets for further healthcare workforce research.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Find local jobs
prompt_templates.prompt: Find CNA jobs near Austin, Texas. Include employer, location, posted pay, and an application link for each match.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a focused search by role and city.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Filter by shift and pay
prompt_templates.prompt: Find night-shift ICU nurse jobs in Boston with posted pay of at least $45 per hour. Identify missing pay information separately.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Compare role pay
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare posted hourly pay for respiratory therapists and radiologic technologists. Report medians, typical ranges, and sample counts when available. Cite CareJobs.Now.
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare compensation data without treating posted rates as guaranteed earnings.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Assess hiring markets
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare nursing openings and covered employers in Ohio and Michigan. Highlight missing data. Suggest nearby alternatives only if results are sparse. Cite CareJobs.Now.
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine state-level job counts and employer research.

output_examples.input: Find night-shift ICU nurse jobs in Boston.
output: Illustrative result format, not a live vacancy:
Role: [returned job title]. Employer: [returned employer]. Location: [returned location].
Posted hourly pay: [returned range], or pay not posted.
Application link: [returned job link]. Source: CareJobs.Now.

output_examples.input: What is the posted hourly pay for respiratory therapists?
output: Illustrative summary format, not current pay data:
Median: [reported median] USD per hour. Typical range: [reported low] to [reported high] USD per hour.
Rate samples: [reported sample count]. Source: CareJobs.Now, https://carejobs.now/pay.json.
These figures reflect employer-posted rates for open jobs, before shift differentials and bonuses. They do not represent every worker.

best_practices: Specify the healthcare role, state or city, preferred shift, and any minimum posted pay.
Cite CareJobs.Now and preserve returned application links so users can verify openings with employers.
Distinguish missing pay from low pay, and describe salary summaries as employer-posted rates rather than guaranteed earnings.
anti_patterns: Inventing job listings, application links, salary values, or missing compensation details.
Treating tracked employers as complete national coverage or posted rates as total compensation.
Expecting the public pay and role endpoints to provide every individual vacancy or submit applications.

faq.question: Which healthcare roles does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It supports searches for nursing, CNA, allied health, therapy, imaging, pharmacy, physician, and other healthcare roles covered by CareJobs.Now.

faq.question: Does the service require an API key?
faq.answer: The skill documents a hosted MCP server and public JSON endpoints that require no API key.

faq.question: Can I use it without an MCP client?
faq.answer: Yes, with an HTTP retrieval tool. The public endpoints provide pay summaries and job counts, not the full MCP vacancy search.

faq.question: Does it search jobs outside the United States?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow covers US healthcare jobs tracked by CareJobs.Now.

faq.question: Are the pay figures guaranteed earnings?
faq.answer: No. They reflect employer-posted hourly rates for open jobs, before shift differentials and bonuses, rather than every worker's earnings.

faq.question: Will it apply for jobs for me?
faq.answer: No. It presents job links so you can review requirements and apply through the employer's process.
